description: Today, Michael Whatley hosted a Protect Our Kids Press Conference in Lillington. Whatley alongside NC State Senator Jim Burgin, NC State Representative Howard Penny, Harnett County Sheriff Wayne Coats, and Harnett County Sheriff Republican Nominee Aaron Meredith discussed Roy Cooper’s failure to protect our children, including his veto of bills to stop the transgender mutilation of kids, the Parents Bill of Rights, and to keep men out of girls sports. As your next Senator, Whatley will fight Cooper’s radical extremist agenda and protect common-sense conservative values.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Whatley for Senate
title: Michael Whatley Hosts Protect Our Kids Press Conference in Lillington – Michael Whatley for Senate
